versions.subject: rule: DEWMODE webshell
versions.detection:
selection1:
    c-uri|contains|all:
        - '?dwn='
        - '&fn='
selection2:
    c-uri|contains|all:
        - '&dwn='
        - '?fn='
selection_type:
    c-uri|contains:
        - '.html?'
        - '.php?'
condition: ( selection1 or selection2 ) and selection_type
